# ke

**Reserved for a future *knowledge-extraction* package.** Not yet implemented.

## Looking for knowledge *evaluation*?

That’s [`ek`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/ek) — a framework for evaluating
the outputs of information-extraction systems (OCR, agents, and more). This
repo used to hold a first draft of that work; it continued under the name
`ek` (read as “evaluation of knowledge”) and has grown well past what lived
here. See [issue #12](https://github.com/thorwhalen/ke/issues/12) for the
full history.

```bash
pip install ek
```

## What’s here now

Nothing installable yet. `ke` (*knowledge extraction* — the inverse problem:
producing structured knowledge from raw sources) is the name this repo is
reserved for. When that work starts, see
[AGENTS.md]() for the intended shape.

`pip install ke` currently installs an older, unrelated package by the same
author under a different account (a small file-access utility, last released
2025-06-17, no longer in use). That release is not superseded by anything in
this repo yet — publishing from here is disabled
(`[tool.wads.ci.publish] enabled = false`) until there is knowledge-extraction
code worth shipping.

<p class="epythet-aggregates">This documentation as a single file: <a href="ke.md">ke.md</a> (Markdown, for agents).</p>


# _autosummary/ke.html.md

# ke

`ke` – reserved for a future knowledge-*extraction* package.

This repository used to hold a first draft of knowledge-*evaluation* tooling.
That work continued under the name [ek](https://github.com/thorwhalen/ek)
(read as “evaluation of knowledge”) and has since grown well past what lived
here – see `ek`’s own documentation for evaluating information-extraction
outputs (OCR, agents, and more).

`ke` itself is kept empty and reserved for knowledge *extraction* (the
inverse problem: producing structured knowledge from raw sources), which is
not yet implemented. See
[issue #12](https://github.com/thorwhalen/ke/issues/12) for the history of
this reset and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for what a future build here
should look like.

# For AI agents

`ke` ships artifacts for coding agents alongside its code. This page lists
them, says where each lives in the repository, and points at the
machine-readable copies of this documentation.

## Instruction files

Files agents read before working in this repository.

- [`.claude/CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/ke/tree/HEAD/.claude/CLAUDE.md): read by Claude Code
- [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/ke/tree/HEAD/AGENTS.md): read by Codex, Copilot, Cursor and other agents

## Machine-readable documentation

This site publishes the same documentation in forms that fit an agent’s context window:

- [`llms.txt`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/ke/llms.txt): an index of every page with a one-line description ([llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) format)
- [`ke.md`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/ke/ke.md): the whole documentation as one Markdown file
- `<page>.html.md`: a rendered Markdown twin of every page, advertised from each page’s `<head>` with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`
- [`objects.inv`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/ke/objects.inv): the Sphinx inventory: a symbol-to-URL index (`sphobjinv convert plain objects.inv -`)
